verdict: Leads are coming in; cost per lead rose this week and intake needs tightening.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 176 leads at an average cost of $12.59 per lead, with all paid activity running through Meta. In the most recent 7 days, lead volume dipped 15.69% while spend rose 3.47%, pushing cost per lead up roughly 23% — efficiency is eroding, not collapsing, and a strong single-day return of 9 leads on October 11 suggests the drop carries noise. We're reviewing the active campaign's creative and audience to arrest the cost trend before it widens. Separately, 26 of your incoming leads are not yet reflected in your CRM pipeline, and no opportunities have been created from those contacts; tightening that intake process is the immediate priority alongside the ad-side work.
